retained_conditions.reason: 4096-byte buffer, output-path failure, synchronized SIGHUP cwd/HOME and SIGINT command-mode recovery, plus isolated tmpfile EMFILE and backing fwrite ENOSPC injection. These satisfy the retained bounded-fixture capability; physical capacity and other interruption timings remain open.
